ja: ずっと憧れてたあの城に、やっと来られた！
en: I finally made it to the castle I've dreamed of.
alternatives: I'm finally at the castle I've always dreamed of.
I've finally made it to the castle I've dreamed of.
I finally got to the castle I've always dreamed of.
point: 「やっと来られた」は made it to ～ で言える

ja: 彼女、あの絵をもう30分も見つめてるよ。
en: She's been glued to that painting for thirty minutes.
alternatives: She's been staring at that painting for half an hour.
She's been gazing at that painting for half an hour.
point: 今も続く動作は has been + ing、期間は for で表す

ja: 夜のクルーズって、参加したことある？
en: Have you ever been on the night cruise?
alternatives: Have you ever taken the night cruise?
Have you ever gone on the night cruise?
Have you ever been on a night cruise?
point: 経験は Have you ever + 過去分詞で尋ねる

ja: 私たち、絶対気に入ると言われた場所、どの地図にも載ってない。
en: The place we were told we'd love isn't on any map.
alternatives: The spot we were told we'd love isn't on any map.
None of the maps show the place we were told we'd love.
point: 「場所」を修飾する節の中にさらに節が入る形

ja: 写真じゃ伝わらないのは、この滝の音の迫力だよね。
en: What photos can't capture is the roar of this waterfall.
alternatives: The thing photos can't capture is the roar of this waterfall.
Photos can't capture the roar of this waterfall.
point: What 節が主語。is の後ろに伝えたい中身を置く

ja: 雨なら、ツアーは中止になりますか？
en: Is the tour canceled if it rains?
alternatives: Is the tour canceled when it rains?
Do they cancel it if it rains?
point: 未来のことでも if 節は現在形で it rains

ja: ツアーに入ってなかったら、この穴場は見つけられなかったね。
en: If we hadn't joined the tour, we'd never have found this gem.
alternatives: If we hadn't taken the tour, we'd never have found this spot.
If not for the tour, we'd never have found this gem.
point: 過去の仮定は If + had + 過去分詞、主節は would have + 過去分詞

ja: この橋を誰が建てたか、ご存じですか？
en: Do you know who built this bridge?
alternatives: Could you tell me who built this bridge?
Would you know who built this bridge?
point: 間接疑問は who が主語なので do を使わず built のまま

ja: 日の出ツアーに参加するつもりなんだ。
en: I'm going to join the sunrise tour.
alternatives: I plan to join the sunrise tour.
I'm going to take the sunrise tour.
point: 前から決めていた予定は be going to

ja: 友達が入口で待ってるんだ。
en: My friend is waiting at the entrance.
alternatives: My friend's waiting by the entrance.
A friend is waiting at the entrance.
point: 今している最中のことは be動詞 + 〜ing で表す

ja: この街の観光情報って、何かありますか？
en: Do you have any information on local sights?
alternatives: Could I get some information about local sights?
Is there any sightseeing info for this town?
point: information は数えられない名詞。an や複数形は不可

ja: 父はガイドさんの話に聞き入って、メモを取ってたよ。
en: My dad hung on the guide's every word, taking notes.
alternatives: My dad listened closely to the guide, taking notes.
My dad took notes, hanging on the guide's every word.
point: 同時の動作は , taking notes と分詞で後ろに足す

ja: ここは写真を撮れるって聞いたよ。
en: I heard we can take photos here.
alternatives: I was told photos are allowed here.
I heard photography is allowed here.
point: heard の後の that は省略できる。can は「許可」も表す

ja: みんな作品じゃなくて、眺めが目当てで来るんですよ。
en: It's the view, not the art, that people come for.
alternatives: What people come for is the view, not the art.
People come for the view, not for the art.
point: 強調したい部分を It's と that の間に挟む

ja: ガイドさんが言ってた店、閉まってたよ。
en: The shop the guide mentioned was closed.
alternatives: The shop that the guide mentioned was closed.
That shop the guide mentioned was closed.
point: 目的格の関係詞 that は省略できる

ja: ツアーは毎朝10時に始まる。
en: Tours start at ten every morning.
alternatives: Tours begin at ten every morning.
The tour starts at ten daily.
point: 複数の Tours なら動詞は start（s なし）

ja: 雨だったのに、ツアーは思ったより楽しかったよ。
en: Despite the rain, the tour was better than expected.
alternatives: Even though it rained, the tour was better than expected.
It rained, but the tour was more fun than expected.
point: 「〜なのに」は Despite + 名詞、Even though + 文

ja: 展望台の景色、撮っておけばよかったなあ。
en: I wish I'd taken pictures from the lookout.
alternatives: I should've taken a photo from the lookout.
I wish I'd taken photos at the lookout.
point: 過去への後悔は I wish + had + 過去分詞

ja: あの人たち、最終ツアーに出たに違いない。
en: They must have taken the last tour.
alternatives: They must have gone on the last tour.
They must have joined the last tour.
point: 過去の推量「〜したに違いない」は must have + 過去分詞

ja: あの、写真を撮っていただけないかと思いまして。
en: I was wondering if you could take our picture.
alternatives: Would you mind taking our picture, please?
Could you possibly take a picture of us?
point: 丁寧な依頼は I was wondering if you could と過去形で

ja: ここ、昔は無料だったのに、今は入場料を取るんだね。
en: It used to be free, but now they charge admission.
alternatives: It used to be free, but now there's a fee.
This place used to be free, but now they charge.
It used to be free, but you pay now.
point: 過去の状態は used to、今は現在形で対比する

ja: 私たち、夕日を見にここまで来たんです。
en: We came here to see the sunset.
alternatives: We came all this way for the sunset.
We traveled here to watch the sunset.
point: 目的の「〜しに」は to + 動詞の原形

ja: 地図を一枚もらえますか？
en: Can I have a map, please?
alternatives: Could I get a map, please?
Could you give me a map?
point: 数えられる名詞の「一枚」は a をつける

ja: 僕が早く予約してれば、特別展に入れたのに。
en: If I'd booked earlier, I could've gotten in.
alternatives: Had I booked earlier, I could've gotten in.
If I had booked sooner, I would've gotten in.
point: 過去の後悔は if + had + 過去分詞、could have + 過去分詞

ja: この町、まず見るべき場所は？
en: What should I see first here?
alternatives: What should I visit first here?
What should I see first in town?
point: 疑問詞のあとは should I の語順

ja: ガイドさんが、上は風が強いって言ってたよ。
en: The guide said it was windy at the top.
alternatives: Our guide told us it was windy up there.
The guide said it was really windy up top.
point: said の後は時制を合わせて it was にする

ja: ネットで予約してたら、私たち今ごろ中にいたのにね。
en: If we'd booked online, we'd be inside by now.
alternatives: If we had booked online, we'd already be inside.
We'd be inside now if we'd booked online.
point: 過去の仮定は had booked、今の結果は would be

ja: 私たち、係員にあそこに並ぶよう言われた。
en: The staff told us to line up there.
alternatives: We were told to line up over there.
An attendant told us to line up there.
point: tell + 人 + to do。「並ぶ」は line up

ja: 私たち、時間指定制だと知ってたら、早めに予約したのに。
en: Had we known about timed entry, we'd have booked earlier.
alternatives: If we'd known about timed entry, we'd have booked earlier.
If we'd known entry was timed, we'd have booked sooner.
point: 「知っていたら」は If we'd known を Had we known と倒置できる

ja: もし1日だけなら、あなたはどこ行く？
en: If you had one day, where'd you go?
alternatives: Where'd you go if you had one day?
If you had a day, where'd you go?
point: 仮の話は if 節を過去形、主節は would

ja: 観光のアドバイスを少しもらえますか？
en: Could you give me some sightseeing advice?
alternatives: Can you give me some sightseeing tips?
Could I get some advice about sightseeing?
point: advice は数えられない名詞。an advice や advices は不可

ja: 何週間も前に予約したのに、向こうに記録がなかったんだ。
en: We'd booked weeks ago, but they had no record.
alternatives: We had booked weeks in advance, but they had no record.
We'd reserved weeks ago, yet they had no record of it.
point: 記録がなかった時点より前の予約は過去完了 had booked

ja: 入口に並んでる人たちは、ツアーの参加者ですか？
en: Are those people lined up outside part of the tour?
alternatives: Are those people at the entrance on the tour?
Are the people waiting at the entrance on the tour?
point: 「並んでる人たち」は people の後ろに分詞を置く

ja: 今朝のお寺が断トツで一番よかったね。
en: This morning's temple was by far the best.
alternatives: The temple this morning was easily the best.
This morning's temple was hands down the best.
point: 最上級の強調は by far を the best の前に置く

ja: ここが撮影禁止だなんて、知りませんでした。
en: I had no idea photography was banned here.
alternatives: I didn't realize photos weren't allowed here.
I wasn't aware photos weren't allowed here.
point: 「知らなかった」は I had no idea + that 節。

ja: ホテルで勧められた展望台って、歩いて行ける？
en: Is the lookout the hotel recommended within walking distance?
alternatives: Can we walk to the lookout the hotel recommended?
Is the viewpoint the hotel suggested within walking distance?
point: the lookout のすぐ後ろに the hotel recommended と続ける

ja: 近くにいい博物館はありますか？
en: Is there a good museum nearby?
alternatives: Are there any good museums nearby?
Is there a nice museum nearby?
point: 「ありますか」は Is there で始める

ja: 着いたら、行列がもう建物をぐるっと囲んでたよ。
en: When we arrived, the line had snaked around the block.
alternatives: The line had already wrapped around the block when we arrived.
When we got there, the line had wrapped around the block.
point: 着いた時点より前に起きたことは過去完了 had snaked

ja: 先にネットでチケット買おうよ。
en: Let's buy the tickets online first.
alternatives: Let's get the tickets online first.
Why don't we buy tickets online first?
point: 「〜しようよ」は Let's のあとに動詞の原形

ja: ガイドさんに私の写真を撮ってもらった。
en: I had the guide take my photo.
alternatives: I got the guide to take my photo.
I had the guide take my picture.
point: 「〜してもらう」は have + 人 + 原形（to は付けない）

ja: すみません、先にリュックを預けてもいいですか？
en: Is it okay to drop off my backpack first?
alternatives: Can I drop off my backpack first?
May I drop my backpack off first?
point: 「預ける」は drop off、荷物は off の前後どちらも可

ja: 入口の警備員さんに聞いてたら、わかったのに。
en: If I'd asked the gate guard, I'd have known.
alternatives: Had I asked the guard, I'd have known.
If I'd just asked the guard, I'd have known.
point: 過去の反対は If + had + 過去分詞、主節は would have + 過去分詞

ja: 展望台がこんなに混むとは、思ってもみなかった。
en: I never thought the lookout would be this packed.
alternatives: I never imagined the lookout would be this crowded.
I never expected the lookout to be this crowded.
point: thought の後ろの that は省略可。would で過去から見た未来

ja: 私、ここは三回来てるけど、塔に登ったのは去年が初めて。
en: I've been here three times, but only climbed the tower last year.
alternatives: I've visited three times, but only climbed the tower last year.
I've been here three times, but only went up it last year.
point: 回数は現在完了、last year のある過去は過去形

ja: 私たちが予約したツアー、もう出ましたか？
en: Has the tour we booked already left?
alternatives: Has the tour we booked already set off?
Has the tour we reserved already gone?
point: 「もう」を含む完了の疑問は現在完了で聞く
